dct_description_sm: The 1M Police Jurisdiction Map was created for administrative purposes and is meant to be used by government staff and by external consultants. It displays the Police Jurisdictions boundaries in the province of Alberta. This cartographic quality 1:1 000 000 scale colour maps cover the provincial extent of Alberta and also displays major hydrographic features, municipalities, major roads, and select geoadministrative features (parks, reserves, etc.).
